messages:
lee (AE): Quick heads up 1: Everbranch wants a short pilot to validate extraction + summarization flows. They asked for a one-page scope + golden examples. Need to finalize today to hit procurement window.

tess (SE): Got it. High level constraints: they care about structured extraction accuracy and tail latency on long tickets. Suggest success criteria:
- Extraction F1 >= 0.92 on golden set
- Summary ROUGE-L >= 0.45 (human-validated sample)
- p95 latency < 300ms hosted, <180ms dedicated at 25 RPS
- Regression gate: <= 4% new failures vs baseline

marco (Solutions): Drafting golden set now. Proposed seed items:
1) "Extract invoice fields from noisy OCR text" -> expect {vendor, invoice_no, total_cents}
2) "Shorten long support thread to 3 bullets, preserving action items" -> expect list of bullets
3) "Classify message urgency: low/medium/high" -> expect single label

sam (Security): Blockers flagged by Everbranch: data residency, SSO, SOC2 copy. We can:
- Offer EU region pilot (if their data stays in-region)
- Support SAML SSO for devs during trial
- Provide SOC2 redacted report link (ops-bot will post)
But Private/on-prem option requires longer lead time (~3-5w) and separate contract.

contracts-bot: Reminder: pilot addendum template (time-limited data retention + opt-out clause) available at /legal/pilot-addendum-v2.pdf

ops-bot: SOC2 (redacted) available at https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2-2025 (access controls apply)

lee (AE): Pricing question: they want a simple model: flat pilot fee (2-week) + token overage. Can we add optional Dedicated bridge for last 3 days if they want to stress test?

tess (SE): Yes. Recommend: pilot fee covers hosted baseline up to X tokens + optional Dedicated bridge priced as daily reserved unit (flat). We'll add clear assumptions (avg token length, estimated RPS).

marco (Solutions): Tiny note on eval harness: include both automated checks (JSON schema, embedding similarity threshold) and a 10% human review sample. For embeddings threshold, we should calibrate on their sample docs to avoid false negatives.

sam (Security): Also confirm logging retention for pilot: default 90d, can reduce to 30d for pilot-only agreement. Flagging to legal for language.

lee (AE): Action items:
- Marco: upload golden set + skeleton harness by 3pm
- Tess: draft pilot pricing lines and assumptions
- Sam: send SOC2 link + SSO notes to Everbranch
- Lee: send pilot addendum + request sample data (PII-redacted)

marco (Solutions): Will run a quick calibration job on their sample once received and report recommended embedding thresholds.

lee (AE): Thanks team. I'll post the one-page scope to Everbranch after we close the golden set. Ping in thread with any updates. :thumbsup:
